classification.difficultyReason: Read lengths from a grid and subtract a triangular notch from a trapezium.

content.prompt: Find the area of the figure shown below.

spec.description: A six-by-six square grid containing a concave pentagon. The polygon requires custom TikZ because a blank-grid template cannot express its boundary and inward notch. Decorative source red fill is omitted.
spec.mathematics: Vertices in boundary order are (1,1), (5,1), (4,5), (3,4), (2,5), with the bottom-left grid intersection as (0,0). Every grid line is retained; no numerical labels are printed.
spec.answerVisibility: No answer or dissection is supplied in the question figure.

answer.short:
$11$ square units.

Subtract the triangular notch from the enclosing trapezium.
answer.worked:
The enclosing trapezium has parallel sides of $4$ and $2$ units and height $4$ units. The notch has base $2$ units and height $1$ unit.
$$\begin{align*}A_{\text{trapezium}}&=\frac{(4+2)\times4}{2}\\A_{\text{trapezium}}&=12\\A_{\text{notch}}&=\frac{2\times1}{2}\\A_{\text{notch}}&=1\\A_{\text{figure}}&=12-1\\A_{\text{figure}}&=11\text{ square units}.\end{align*}$$
